description: This file defines the 'Activity' class within the 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Account' namespace. The class includes methods for managing customer activity records, such as adding and deleting activity logs. It interacts with the database to persist and remove customer activity data, indicating its role within the account activity logging functionality of the OpenCart system.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A class managing the logging of customer activity data in the database, including adding new activity entries and deleting existing ones for specific customers.

methods.name: addActivity
methods.description: Adds a new activity record for a customer, inserting details such as the key, data (JSON-encoded), IP address, and timestamp into the database.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Removes all activity records associated with a specific customer ID from the database.
